nodes.title: The weld: what had to be proved, and what 'accepted' certifies
nodes.note: The carry-cocycle laws of the previous stage are theorems about a model: harness towers with standard lifts, built to imitate one branch of the classifier. The classifier itself (stage 1) computes with different raw material — $\varphi$-adic developments, residual polynomial operators, Newton-polygon transports, GMN key polynomials. The weld is the theorem package saying the model IS the classifier's calculus, exactly: four junction notes match the two sides piece by piece, a fifth discharges the lift-normalization corner, and a sixth consolidates them into one transport. Certification vocabulary, restated: each note is ACCEPTED — two consecutive clean hostile passes by fresh-context verifiers, sealed machine batteries on every arc, all failures dated on the record. That is a strong adversarial bar and a strictly weaker certificate than a Lean proof.
nodes.math: The four junctions: W-2 (the lift junction — which representative polynomial the model tower stands for, and how the answer covaries with the choice); J-A (the dictionary junction — type data to tower data, four operator equalities and a per-slot character-gauge law); J-B (the tree junction — polygons and gradings transport level-to-level by the explicit affine shear $\Sigma_q(i,u) = (i,\, e_q u + h_q i)$); J-C (the carry-algebra junction — anchor multiplication lands in the twisted group algebra $K^c[\mathbb{Z}/E]$). Plus the lift corner (the one stratum where the lift-normalization law had been open) and THEOREM WELD-M (next nodes).

nodes.title: Why a cocycle at all: carries in positional notation are the factor set of the value-group extension — and the wild class dies over a finite field
nodes.note: The general-reader story behind the whole stage, from a dated interpretation note (2026-08-07). Its status deserves care: the gcd computation below is classical algebra; the two headline identifications were MEASURED on committed towers by scratch instruments — disclosed verbatim but NOT sealed, so below even this page's 'measured' bar — and nothing in the development rides on them. The story: a wild tower grows the value group in stages, $\mathbb{Z} \subset \frac{1}{e_0}\mathbb{Z} \subset \cdots \subset \frac{1}{E}\mathbb{Z}$, and every exponent splits into level digits — a mixed-radix positional notation. Adding two exponents produces carries, and the carry table of positional notation is precisely the classical 2-cocycle (the 'factor set') presenting the extension $0 \to \mathbb{Z} \to \frac{1}{E}\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}/E \to 0$: measured on three committed towers, the section carry's class is $1$ — the fundamental class, the generator of $H^2(\mathbb{Z}/E, \mathbb{Z}) \cong \mathbb{Z}/E$. The model's carry cocycle prices each of these integer carries by a residual letter, landing the class in $H^2(\mathbb{Z}/E, K^*)$.
nodes.math: Now the classical computation: for a finite field $K$, $H^2(\mathbb{Z}/E, K^*) \cong \mathbb{Z}/\gcd(E, |K| - 1)$ — the tame quotient. At a wild tower $E$ is a power of the residue characteristic $p$, and $|K| - 1$ is prime to $p$: so the wild part of the carry class PROVABLY DIES at class level (measured on the committed towers: the one tower with a tame step keeps exactly its tame quadratic symbol; the all-wild classes are trivial). This is the high-level explanation of the campaign's method, and of the fence the carry-algebra junction had to draw between presentation and class: at wild primes there is nothing at cohomology-class level to compute — all wild information lives at cochain level — so the proof MUST run explicit cochain bookkeeping with fences (the ledger this whole page documents) rather than a class-level machinery invocation. The same note tests three other high-powered frames (Witt vectors, motivic integration, Herbrand functions) and records exactly where each breaks against committed witnesses.
